_key.description: Genomic element key, the Ensembl ID of the readout gene and the source file accession joined by underscores.

effect_size.description: Signed relative change in target-gene expression after CRISPRi of the element (ENCODE EffectSize). Negative values mean lower expression. Missing values are stored as 0.

log2FC.description: Log2 of one plus EffectSize. Computed at load; the source file does not have this column. Negative values mean lower expression.

p_value.description: Uncorrected differential-expression p-value for the element–gene pair. Null when the source has none.

p_value_adj.description: Benjamini–Hochberg FDR of the differential-expression test. Null when the source has none.

neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log10 of the uncorrected p-value. Capped at 240 when the reported p-value is 0. Null when the source has none.

neg_log10_pvalue_adj.description: Negative log10 of the Benjamini–Hochberg FDR. Capped at 240 when the reported FDR is 0. Null when the source has none.

significant.description: Whether the combined dataset calls the pair significant (adjusted p-value below 0.05).

crispr_modality.description: CRISPR interference, from the associated files_filesets record.

enum: regulatory element effect on gene expression

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the ENCODE combined CRISPR quantification file this pair was read from.

biological_context.description: Tissue the screen was run in. This file used K562.

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for K562, as a handle into ontology_terms.

accessible_via.return: class, label, method, crispr_modality, source, source_url, files_filesets, biological_context, biosample_term, effect_size, log2FC, p_value
